def transfer_solution(h, n_old, n_new):
    dx_old = 2.0 / n_old
    dx_new = 2.0 / n_new
    h_new = np.zeros(n_new)
    for j in range(n_new):
        x = j * dx_new
        # Find corresponding point in old grid
        i = int(round(x / dx_old))
        i = max(0, min(i, n_old-1))
        h_new[j] = h[i]
    # Adjust sum to target
    current_sum = np.sum(h_new)
    scale = target_sum / current_sum if current_sum != 0 else 1.0
    h_new = h_new * scale
    # Clip to [0,1]
    h_new = np.clip(h_new, 0, 1)
    # Final adjustment to ensure sum
    final_sum = np.sum(h_new)
    if abs(final_sum - target_sum) > 1e-3:
        h_new = h_new * (target_sum / final_sum)
    return h_new
